text:
Evan: Whos up for a late-week soccer lounge? Small bet: winner gets to pick the next office playlist for a day. :soccer:

Mina: In. Playlist power is dangerous, love it. Whats the bet?

Josh: $3 and a trophy (paper crown). Low stakes. Also snacks?

Aly: I can bring empanadas (vegan options). Whos streaming?

Rhea: Ill set up the living room TV. Need someone with the HDMI dongle.

Evan: Evan / Team Blue / $3 / crown tiebreaker: who scores first (player name)

Mina: Mina / Team Red / $3 / tiebreaker: minute of first goal

Josh: Josh / Team Blue / no snack / tiebreaker: minute

Aly: Aly / Team Red / bringing empanadas + plates / tiebreaker: minute

SnackBot: Local pick: "La Plaza" empanada tray $24, small salad $10. ETA 30-45 min. Recommend ordering 20 min before kickoff.

Rhea: HDMI confirmed, bringing spare remote. Ari (roommate) left a fuzzy blanket in the closet if anyone wants it.

Mina: Can we add a silly penalty: loser has to wear the crown in the next all-hands for 30 seconds?

Evan: Yes. Also loser posts the champion GIF in #random with a dramatic caption.

Josh: GIF commitment accepted. Also quick rule: picks lock at kickoff. No last-minute bandwagoning.

Aly: Adding my empanada tally: 6 veg, 6 meat. If anyone has allergies shout now.

Rhea: Noted. Ill queue the stream; backup link in #eng-streams if the main dies.

SnackBot: Order queued: empanada tray x1, small salad x1. Delivery note: 2nd floor kitchen.

Mina: Also small side-bet: who will do the best victory dance? Winner picks the soundtrack that the loser must dance to.

Josh: Dangerous but yes. Marking my victory dance as "awkward robot".

Evan: Love it. If overtime, loser buys coffee for the office the next morning. Stakes escalate.

Aly: Sheet posted: name / pick / snack / tiebreaker. Link in thread.

Rhea: Reminder to mute work notifications before we start. Ill bring a set of reusable plates.

Evan: See you all at kickoff. May the best (or most dramatic) fan win. :crown: :confetti_ball:
